name: Login sends one complete client config and the account's character list
contract: SMSG_UPDATE_CONFIGS (0x058D) replaces the DLL's integer, boolean, float and rate maps wholesale, so every value must travel in one packet: the XP rates, the Help menu's CONFIG_ALLOW_TICKETS, the inspect frame's CONFIG_CHARACTER_ADVANCEMENT_BUILD_INSPECT_ENABLED and the Item Recovery flag. SMSG_ACCOUNT_INFO (0x09BB) fills C_AccountInfo, which the ticket window lists characters from: u32 unused, u32 GM level, u8 newcomer, u8 guide, then per character its name, GENDER_ token, u32 level, CLASS_ and RACE_ tokens and faction. Expected: one config packet at login holding all of those keys, and an account info packet naming the character's class, race and faction.

steps.label: Login sends exactly one config packet
It enables the inspect Build tab
It keeps the Item Recovery flag
Account info names the warrior class
